title.zh: 授予Bruce Donald Mctavish菲律宾公民身份、使其归化为菲律宾公民的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Philippine Citizenship to Bruce Donald Mctavish
title.orig: An Act Granting Philippine Citizenship to Bruce Donald Mctavish

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11161_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Mr. Bruce Donald McTavish is hereby granted Philippine citizenship with all the rights, privileges and prerogatives, and is likewise vested with the duties and obligations appurtenant thereto.

Mr. Bruce Donald McTavish shall take the Oath of Allegiance to the Republic of the Philippines before an officer duly authorized to administer the same. The Oath of Allegiance shall be registered with the Bureau of Immigration.

Upon registration of the Oath of Allegiance, the Bureau of Immigration shall issue a Certificate of Naturalization to Mr. McTavish who shall thereupon enter into the full enjoyment of Philippine citizenship.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
